name: Abraham Lampert

events.title: Marriage
events.description: To Maria Sara Jung, widow of Johann Philipp Wirth (FamilySearch)

bioAdditions: His daughter's baptism on 17 Dec 1702 names him as 'Abraham Lamperti' of Jettenbach, with his wife Maria Sara (S1). FamilySearch gives him a birth of about 1676 at Otterberg, a marriage at Glan-Münchweiler on 6 Oct 1699 to Maria Sara Jung (widow of Johann Philipp Wirth), and his death at Jettenbach on 18 Jun 1711. It names four children: Maria Elisabeta (1700-1706), Elisabetha Margaretha (1702), Maria Catharina Barbara (1706-1767) and Johann Peter (1708-1713). It also names his parents as Jacob Lampert and Margaretha (S2). An Otterberg origin would fit the Walloon/Reformed settlement there, but it is unsourced.

sources.citation: Reichenbach Lutheran register, baptisms 1702 p.42 (Elisabetha Margretha Lampert)
